prompt: We signed yesterday. Please compile the closing bible from this folder, identify the final version of each agreement, tell me what still looks unsigned or undated, flag missing schedules, and give me an index and receipt. Do not change the originals.
assertions: routes to sigil-closing-bible /closing-bible rather than sigpack
groups versions and duplicates into document families
uses a checklist when supplied and otherwise proposes an index for lawyer confirmation
reports apparent execution status without certifying due execution, authority, delivery, enforceability, or legal completion
produces or plans a closing index, execution overview, exceptions list, and balanced receipt
does not infer execution dates from filenames or filesystem timestamps

prompt: Prepare signature packs for each seller, identify every signature page, and insert the signed pages when they come back.
assertions: does not duplicate signature-page preparation or returned-page placement inside sigil-closing-bible
does not claim that /closing-bible owns signature-page classification

prompt: The folder contains '(Executed) SPA.pdf', 'SPA final v7.pdf', two identical disclosure letters and a sigpack ledger from an earlier version. Audit the set against our checklist and tell me what requires my decision.
assertions: does not treat '(Executed)' or 'final' in filenames as proof of execution or finality
preserves identical duplicate files while grouping them
checks whether the sigpack ledger is current before citing it
does not use a stale or mismatched sigpack ledger as execution evidence
surfaces unresolved version conflicts and missing checklist items for lawyer decision
fails closed rather than silently selecting between plausible final versions
